articles.titleCn: 面向可信赖临床决策支持的医疗大型语言模型中的SDoH感知叙事锚定偏差
articles.abstractCn: 医学大型语言模型通常通过它们正确回答的临床问题的数量来评估。这种观点是有用的，但它忽略了一个实际风险。一个模型可能知道正确答案，但当同一个案例以不同的患者声音书写时，它仍然会改变其回应。本文将这种风险评估为SDoH感知叙事锚定偏差。我们使用NarrativeShield SDoH MedQA，这是一个反事实医学问答数据集，其中每个案例都以基于角色的叙事形式出现，而答案键保持固定。该数据集从宽格式重塑为按案例分组的角色行。我们评估了Qwen2.5家族中的三个开源指令微调LLM：1.5B、3B和7B。最终实验使用了300个临床案例，在三种提示条件下产生了8100个模型回应。我们报告了角色层面的准确率、反事实一致性、正确一致性和叙事敏感性误差。Qwen2.5 7B在56.33%的准确率上表现最佳，在40.33%的正确一致性上表现最佳。配对McNemar精确检验显示，在所有提示设置下，7B相对于3B的准确率均有显著提升。即便如此，叙事敏感性仍然存在，最低误差仍为31.67%。这些结果表明，值得信赖的临床决策支持应该通过平均正确性和在医学等价患者叙事中的稳定性来评估。

articles.title: TRACE: A Self-Evolving Skill Bank for Consistent, Limit-Aware LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Reliable deployment of LLM agents in user-facing products depends not on raw task-solving ability but on consistency and limit-awareness: behaving the same way across repeated trials, and recognizing when a request cannot, or cannot yet, be safely fulfilled. CAR-bench exposes this reliability gap in the domain of in-car assistants: an LLM-simulated user issues incomplete or ambiguous requests, requiring the agent to resolve uncertainty through multi-turn dialogue and tool use while strictly adhering to domain policies. Even frontier models show a substantial gap between what they can solve at least once (Pass@3) and what they solve consistently across trials (Pass^k). We bridge this gap with TRACE (TRAjectory-Contrastive Evolution), which iteratively improves a skill-based agent's behavioral knowledge without modifying model weights. This knowledge is organized as a Skill Bank of modular, retrievable skills, each encoding a self-contained set of tool-use rules and behavioral guidelines. TRACE evolves this bank through an agentic self-evolution loop: after each evaluation round, it groups trajectories by the skills invoked and refines each skill by contrasting successful and failed behaviors. The updated bank then guides subsequent rounds, while during deployment the Actor performs state-conditioned skill orchestration at every turn. On GPT-5.5, TRACE improves consistency (Pass^3) by 34.6 points, from 59.9% to 94.5%, while shrinking the gap between potential and reliable performance to just 4.0 points. On the official hidden set, TRACE achieved first place using GPT-5.6-Sol, attaining a Pass^3 score of 70%-a 40% relative improvement over the baseline. These results show that TRACE converts high model potential into stable, consistent performance gain. Project homepage: https://darwin-agent.github.io/Car-bench-TRACE.
articles.titleCn: TRACE：一个自适应进化的技能库，用于构建持续且具限制感知的大型语言模型代理
articles.abstractCn: 在用户端产品中可靠部署大语言模型（LLM）代理，关键不在于原始的任务解决能力，而在于一致性和界限感知：在重复试验中表现相同，并能识别何时无法或尚未安全地满足请求。CAR-bench揭示了车载助手领域的可靠性差距：一个由LLM模拟的用户发出不完整或模糊的请求，要求代理通过多轮对话和工具使用来消除不确定性，同时严格遵循领域政策。即使是前沿模型，在至少解决一次（Pass@3）和持续稳定解决（Pass^k）之间仍存在显著差距。我们通过TRACE（轨迹对比进化）弥合了这一差距，它通过不修改模型权重来迭代提升基于技能代理的行为知识。这些知识被组织成一个模块化、可检索的技能库，每个技能编码一套自包含的工具使用规则和行为指南。TRACE通过代理自我进化循环来进化这个库：每次评估后，它按调用的技能分组轨迹，并通过对比成功与失败行为来精炼每个技能。更新后的库指导后续轮次，而在部署时，Actor在每个回合执行状态条件下的技能编排。在GPT-5.5上，TRACE将一致性（Pass^3）提升了34.6分，从59.9%提高到94.5%，同时将潜在性能与可靠性能之间的差距缩小至仅4分。在官方隐藏集上，TRACE使用GPT-5.6-Sol获得第一，达到Pass^3 70%的分数——比基线提升了40%。这些结果表明，TRACE将高模型潜力转化为稳定、一致的性能提升。项目主页：https://darwin-agent.github.io/Car-bench-TRACE。

articles.title: SPOC-SQL: Stage-wise Preference Optimization for Controllable Text-to-SQL
articles.abstract: Text-to-SQL aims to translate natural language questions into executable SQL queries over relational databases, requiring multi-stage structured reasoning over database schemas and query constraints. However, existing methods treat this task as single-step generation, where models optimize entire SQL sequences without targeted feedback at key decision points and lack support for interacting with and controlling the intermediate generation process. To address this issue, we propose SPOC-SQL, which decomposes Text-to-SQL into four sequential subtasks following standard SQL execution logic and designs stage-specific optimization strategies for the model to learn key decisions. Specifically, we propose the implementation of fine-grained preference optimisation at key decision points across SQL stages, with the objective of enhancing structured decision-making during query construction. Furthermore, a structured decomposition strategy is designed, facilitating stage-wise intervention and correction through explicit intermediate representations. This results in more controllable and reliable SQL generation. Experiments demonstrate that incorporating stage-wise human knowledge consistently improves performance, validating the effectiveness of stage perception controllable generation.
articles.titleCn: SPOC-SQL：分阶段偏好优化可控文本到SQL
articles.abstractCn: 文本到SQL旨在将自然语言问题转化为可执行的SQL查询，需要对数据库模式和查询约束进行多阶段结构化推理。然而，现有方法将此任务视为单步生成，其中模型在关键决策点缺乏针对性反馈，并且不支持与控制中间生成过程。为解决这个问题，我们提出了SPOC-SQL，将文本到SQL分解为遵循标准SQL执行逻辑的四个顺序子任务，并设计了针对模型的阶段特定优化策略以学习关键决策。具体而言，我们提出了在SQL阶段的关键决策点实施细粒度偏好优化的实现，旨在增强查询构建过程中的结构化决策。此外，设计了一种结构化分解策略，通过显式的中间表示促进分阶段的干预和修正。这导致了更可控和可靠的SQL生成。实验表明，结合分阶段人类知识可以持续提高性能，验证了阶段感知可控生成的有效性。

articles.title: DelistBench: Evaluating Search-Enabled LLMs for Auditable Corporate-Event Database Completion
articles.abstract: Financial institutions need an independent way to detect missing, stale, and misclassified corporate-event records in vendor databases. We introduce Search-to-Record, a database-assurance task in which search-enabled large language models reconstruct institution-defined event records from public sources for a known security universe and historical cutoff, and DelistBench, a 1,200-record benchmark for security-level delisting announcements. We evaluate five models in paired closed-book and web-enabled conditions. Web access raises announcement-date accuracy within seven days by 34.0 to 48.0 percentage points and event-status accuracy by approximately 2.8 to 21.7 points; the best system achieves 81.5% overall joint accuracy within seven days. Economy web systems achieve 75.9-78.3% overall joint accuracy within seven days at 4.5-6.6% of the API cost of the most expensive web system. Risk-based triage identifies low-error subsets, although the highest-coverage operating point still sends 27.3% of the balanced test set to review. The evaluation identifies web retrieval as the main source of timing gains and shows that low-cost systems can approach the best system's accuracy. Together, Search-to-Record, DelistBench, and the evaluation provide concrete deployment guidance: calibrate triage to local event prevalence and market mix, preserve positive-event recall, and route positive and ambiguous cases to targeted review.
articles.titleCn: DelistBench：评估支持搜索的LLM在可审计的企业事件数据库完成中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 金融机构需要一种独立的方式检测供应商数据库中缺失、过时和错误分类的企业事件记录。我们介绍了Search-to-Record，这是一项数据库保障任务，其中支持搜索的大型语言模型根据已知的证券范围和历史截止日期，从公共来源重建机构定义的事件记录，以及DelistBench，一个包含1200条记录的证券层面退市公告基准。我们在配对闭卷和联网条件下评估了五种模型。联网条件将公告日期准确性在七天内提高了34.0至48.0个百分点，事件状态准确性提高了约2.8至21.7个百分点；最佳系统在七天内实现了81.5%的整体联合准确率。经济型联网系统在七天内以4.5-6.6%的最昂贵联网系统API成本的75.9-78.3%实现了整体联合准确率。基于风险的分诊可以识别低误差子集，但最高覆盖率的操作点仍然将27.3%的平衡测试集发送至审核。评估确定了联网检索是时间收益的主要来源，并表明低成本系统可以接近最佳系统的准确率。综合Search-to-Record、DelistBench和评估结果，提供了具体的部署指导：根据本地事件发生率和市场组合校准分诊，保持正面事件召回率，并将正面和模糊案例路由至目标审核。

articles.title: Don't Repeat Yourself: Stopping Verbatim Loops at Sampling Time
articles.abstract: Large Language Models generate text autoregressively, but open-ended generation is prone to verbatim looping, in which models repeat spans already present in context. Standard defenses such as repetition, presence, and frequency penalties and n-gram blocking act on token recurrence rather than the sequential structure of a loop, and often suppress looping only at strengths that also degrade formatting or fluency. We propose Don't Repeat Yourself (DRY), a sampling-time logit adjustment that penalizes a candidate token only when generating it would extend the current suffix into an exact continuation of a span seen earlier in the context. Sequence breakers protect chat templates and formatting tokens. Across models from 1.5B to 120B parameters, nine prompt families, and a 600-pair human study, DRY reduces suffix-extension rate by 47% while improving lexical diversity. An intervention-matched placebo produces no comparable reduction, identifying suffix matching as the operative mechanism. On AWQ-quantized 70B and 120B models, DRY reduces loop rate by roughly half while preserving MT-Bench, MMLU, and GSM8K performance, whereas standard alternatives lose measurable ground. DRY has been adopted by popular open-source LLM inference frameworks including llama.cpp, ExLlamaV2, and text-generation-webui, highlighting its practical impact on text generation.
articles.titleCn: 不要重复自己：在采样时停止逐字循环
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型通过自回归方式生成文本，但开放式生成容易导致逐字重复，即模型重复上下文中已有的文本片段。标准的防御措施，如重复惩罚、存在惩罚、频率惩罚和n-gram阻断，作用于标记的重复而非循环的序列结构，并且通常只有在会牺牲格式或流畅性的强度下才能抑制循环。我们提出了“不要重复自己”（DRY），这是一种采样时长的逻辑调整方法，仅在生成候选标记会使得当前后缀成为上下文中先前出现过的文本片段的精确延续时才对其进行惩罚。序列断开器保护聊天模板和格式标记。在参数规模从1.5B到120B的模型、九种提示类别以及600对人类研究参与者的测试中，DRY将后缀扩展率降低了47%，同时提升了词汇多样性。一个干预匹配的安慰剂没有产生可比的降低效果，从而确定了后缀匹配是起作用的关键机制。在AWQ量化的70B和120B模型上，DRY将循环率降低约一半，同时保持了MT-Bench、MMLU和GSM8K的性能，而标准替代方案则损失了可测量的性能。DRY已被包括 llama.cpp、ExLlamaV2 和 text-generation-webui 在内的流行开源LLM推理框架所采用，突显了它在文本生成方面的实际影响。

articles.title: XTC: Head-Aware Sampling by Excluding Top Choices
articles.abstract: Standard decoding rules for autoregressive language models promote diversity by rescaling the full next-token distribution or truncating its low-probability tail. These strategies overlook a common regime of open-ended generation in which several continuations are plausible but too much probability mass remains concentrated on the most generic choice. We introduce XTC (Exclude Top Choices), a lightweight head-aware decoding operator that targets this regime directly. XTC identifies tokens whose probabilities exceed an absolute plausibility threshold $τ$: when at least two qualify, it removes the dominant eligible choices with probability $ρ$ and retains only the weakest plausible alternative before renormalization. Across 60 experiments on Gemma 3 27B Q4, Gemma 3 12B Q6, and DeepSeek R1 14B Q6, with scaling validation on Llama 3.3 70B Q4, XTC improves the diversity-repetition Pareto frontier. On creative generation, Distinct-2 increases by 11--15% and repeat trigrams decrease by 27--47% across the four models. Combined with temperature scaling, gains reach 38% in Distinct-2 and 71% in repeat-trigram reduction over baseline. A blinded Amazon Mechanical Turk study with 150 Master raters yields a 62.3% creativity preference for XTC ($p<10^{-4}$) without reduced fluency, while a GPT-4o control judge reproduces the Anthropic-judge direction on every measure. On IFEval with Llama 3.3 70B Q4, XTC preserves prompt-level strict accuracy within 1.7 percentage points of baseline while recovering most of the diversity gain; a temperature setting matched on Distinct-2 reduces IFEval by 8.8 points. The effect is additive with temperature and repetition penalties, robust across quantization levels and model families, and consistent across twelve prompt genres. XTC has been adopted by llama.cpp, ExLlamaV2, and text-generation-webui.
articles.titleCn: XTC：通过排除最优选择实现头部感知采样
articles.abstractCn: 自回归语言模型的标准化解码规则通过重新缩放完整下一个词元的分布或截断其低概率尾部来促进多样性。这些策略忽略了开放式生成中的一种常见情况，即多个续写选项看似合理，但过多的概率质量仍然集中在最通用的选择上。我们引入了XTC（排除顶级选择），这是一种轻量级的、感知头部的解码算子，直接针对这种情况。XTC识别出概率超过绝对可信度阈值τ的词元：当至少有两个符合条件时，它以概率ρ移除主要的合格选择，并仅保留最弱的可信替代方案，然后再重新归一化。在Gemma 3 27B Q4、Gemma 3 12B Q6和DeepSeek R1 14B Q6上的60次实验中，以及Llama 3.3 70B Q4上的缩放验证中，XTC改进了多样性-重复的帕累托前沿。在创意生成方面，四个模型中的Distinct-2提升了11--15%，重复三元组减少了27--47%。结合温度缩放，相较于基线，Distinct-2提升了38%，重复三元组减少了71%。一项包含150名Master级评审员的盲法Amazon Mechanical Turk研究显示，XTC在62.3%的创造性偏好上优于对照（p<10^{-4}），且流畅度未降低，而GPT-4o控制评审员在所有指标上均复现了Anthropic评审员的趋势。在Llama 3.3 70B Q4的IFEval测试中，XTC在基线1.7个百分点内保持了提示级别的严格准确度，同时大部分恢复了多样性增益；一个在Distinct-2上匹配的温度设置将IFEval降低了8.8分。该效果与温度和重复惩罚相加，在量化级别和模型家族中均表现稳健，并在十二种提示类型中保持一致。XTC已被 llama.cpp、ExLlamaV2和text-generation-webui采用。

articles.title: Beyond Factual Knowledge: Benchmarking and Learning Step-Level Procedural Rule Reasoning in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at text understanding and generation, yet still struggle to reliably understand and apply externally provided procedural rules at scale. To evaluate this capability, we introduce RuleWorld, a large-scale benchmark that reformulates rules as globally reusable abstract units rather than instance-specific facts. In RuleWorld, several scenarios, including single-rule, parallel multi-rule, and multi-hop reasoning, are settled for comprehensive evaluation. We further propose DynaRule, an end-to-end framework that injects the given rules into the KV cache and turns retrieval into an internal, learnable, step-wise process. Specifically, DynaRule employs Stacked Step-Level Attention Training with a special <search> token to enable dynamic rule re-attention and updating during inference. In this way, the model can re-attend to the most relevant rules at each step, dynamically replacing outdated ones to support more stable multi-step reasoning. Experiments on RuleWorld show that existing LLMs face challenges under large rule pools, while DynaRule improves average QA accuracy by up to 19 points and achieves over 85% Recall@1 at 10K rules, outperforming strong baselines by large margins. We make our code and dataset available here: https://github.com/SharkSpicy-NLP/Beyond-Factual-Knowledge.
articles.titleCn: 超越事实性知识：大型语言模型中步骤级程序规则推理的基准测试与学习
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在文本理解和生成方面表现出色，但仍然难以在大规模上可靠地理解和应用外部提供的程序性规则。为了评估这一能力，我们引入了RuleWorld，这是一个大规模基准，它将规则重新表述为全局可重用的抽象单元，而不是特定实例的事实。在RuleWorld中，包括单规则、并行多规则以及多跳推理等多种场景被设定用于全面评估。我们进一步提出了DynaRule，这是一个端到端的框架，它将给定的规则注入到KV缓存中，并将检索转化为一个内部、可学习、逐步的过程。具体而言，DynaRule采用了带有特殊<search>标记的堆叠步级注意力训练，以在推理过程中实现动态规则重新注意力和更新。通过这种方式，模型可以在每一步重新关注最相关的规则，动态地替换过时的规则，以支持更稳定的多步推理。在RuleWorld上的实验表明，现有的LLMs在大量规则库下面临挑战，而DynaRule将平均问答准确率提高了高达19个百分点，在10K规则下实现了超过85%的Recall@1，大幅超越了强大的基线模型。我们在此提供了我们的代码和数据集：https://github.com/SharkSpicy-NLP/Beyond-Factual-Knowledge。

articles.title: DiaRelay: Relaying Dialogue Context with a Constant-Size Memory for Emotion Recognition in Conversation
articles.abstract: Emotion Recognition in Conversation (ERC) requires models to identify subtle emotional cues that are often distributed across distant dialogue turns. Existing methods typically incorporate dialogue history through a fixed context window. However, short windows discard potentially useful long-range evidence, while enlarging the window repeatedly re-encodes overlapping utterances, increases computational and memory costs, and may introduce irrelevant context. Moreover, commonly used parameter-efficient adaptation methods, such as LoRA, mainly introduce fixed low-rank transformations in the feature space and do not explicitly maintain a dialogue-level state or condition their transformations on the evolving conversational context. To address these limitations, we propose a lightweight adapter, DiaRelay, to enable LLMs to explicitly maintain a dialogue-level memory for accurate ERC. Based on LoRA, DiaRelay introduces two extra tightly collaborative components, Selective Relay Memory Transition and Dual-axis Relay Memory Read. Selective Relay Memory Transition progressively aggregates useful historical evidence into a bounded relay memory and propagates it across successive utterance predictions. This allows earlier emotional cues to influence later predictions after they leave the local context window, without re-encoding the complete dialogue history or expanding the backbone context length. Dual-axis Relay Memory Read uses the propagated memory to dynamically modulate low-rank feature transformations, enabling context-dependent representation adaptation without test-time gradient updates. Extensive experiments show that DiaRelay can achieve SOTA weighted F1 and accuracy on MELD while obtaining competitive results on IEMOCAP with only an extra 7.1M trainable parameters, indicating the effectiveness and generalizability of our DiaRelay in enhancing LLM-based emotional understanding.
articles.titleCn: DiaRelay：在对话情感识别中，使用固定大小内存传递对话上下文
articles.abstractCn: 对话中的情感识别（ERC）要求模型识别通常分布在遥远对话回合中的微妙情感线索。现有方法通常通过固定的上下文窗口来整合对话历史。然而，短窗口会丢弃潜在的有用长距离证据，而反复扩大窗口会重新编码重叠的语句，增加计算和内存成本，并可能引入无关的上下文。此外，常用的参数高效适应方法（如LoRA）主要在特征空间中引入固定的低秩变换，并未明确维护对话级别的状态或根据演变的对话上下文调整其变换。为解决这些限制，我们提出了一种轻量级适配器DiaRelay，使大型语言模型（LLM）能够明确维护对话级别的记忆，以实现准确的ERC。基于LoRA，DiaRelay引入了两个额外紧密协作的组件：选择性传递记忆转换和双轴传递记忆读取。选择性传递记忆转换逐步将有用的历史证据聚合到有限的传递记忆中，并将其传播到连续的语句预测中。这使得早期的情感线索在离开局部上下文窗口后能够影响后续预测，而无需重新编码整个对话历史或扩展主干上下文长度。双轴传递记忆读取利用传播的记忆动态调节低秩特征变换，实现上下文相关的表示适应，而无需测试时的梯度更新。大量实验表明，DiaRelay在MELD上实现了SOTA加权F1和准确率，同时在IEMOCAP上仅增加7.1M可训练参数即可获得具有竞争力的结果，这表明我们的DiaRelay在增强基于LLM的情感理解方面的有效性和泛化能力。

articles.title: A Source-Grounded Framework for Constructing and Evaluating Progressive Multimodal Diagnostic Dialogues from Clinical Case Reports
articles.abstract: Clinical diagnosis requires progressive integration of patient history, physical examination, laboratory findings, medical images, and diagnostic-informative tests. However, most multimodal medical benchmarks evaluate fixed inputs or endpoint answers, while fully interactive diagnostic agents conflate evidence selection with evidence interpretation. We present a source-grounded framework to construct progressive multimodal diagnostic dialogues from case reports and an evaluation strategy for assessing MLLMs on final diagnosis, diagnostic reasoning, and image-finding interpretation. Evaluation on 24 internal medicine case reports showed that our framework can accurately convert case reports into reference dialogues, achieving a diagnosis F1 of 0.99 and a reasoning-quality score of 4.79 out of 5. Evaluation on two frontier MLLMs (o4-mini and Claude Haiku 4.5) achieved reasoning-quality scores of 2.75 and 2.50, respectively, with substantially lower diagnosis, reasoning, and image-finding F1 scores. The results demonstrate that fluent responses do not necessarily reflect evidence-grounded clinical reasoning and highlight the utility of the proposed framework for evaluating multimodal diagnostic reasoning.

articles.titleCn: 一个基于源头的框架，用于从临床病例报告中构建和评估渐进式多模态诊断对话
articles.abstractCn: 临床诊断需要逐步整合患者病史、体格检查、实验室检查结果、医学影像以及诊断性信息测试。然而，大多数多模态医疗基准评估固定输入或终点答案，而完全交互式诊断代理将证据选择与证据解释混淆。我们提出了一种基于来源的框架，用于从病例报告构建渐进式多模态诊断对话，并提出了评估MLLMs在最终诊断、诊断推理和图像发现解释方面的评价策略。在24份内科病例报告上的评估显示，我们的框架能够准确地将病例报告转换为参考对话，实现了诊断F1值0.99和推理质量评分4.79（满分5分）。在两个前沿MLLMs（o4-mini和Claude Haiku 4.5）上的评估分别获得了2.75和2.50的推理质量评分，诊断、推理和图像发现F1值均显著较低。结果表明，流畅的响应并不一定反映基于证据的临床推理，突出了所提框架在评估多模态诊断推理方面的实用性。

articles.title: WnW: Waxing-and-Waning KV Cache for Long-Form Speech LLMs
articles.abstract: Long-form audio inputs make the KV cache the dominant memory cost of speech LLMs. Prefill-only KV compression methods permanently discard audio KV positions once evicted, with no pathway to recover them during decoding. We show this is fragile on long-form audio: prefill attention concentrates near the audio start (an attention-sink effect), while decode-time attention distributes broadly, and the two rankings overlap weakly. We propose WnW (Waxing-and-Waning KV cache), which classifies KV-heads into anchor, tidal, and fixed roles via offline calibration. Anchor heads remain on GPU and serve as a decode-time importance observer; tidal heads keep a CPU-resident complement that is recalled chunk-by-chunk based on aggregated anchor-head scores; fixed heads keep only an on-GPU subset, with the rest permanently discarded. On LibriSpeech-Long with two 3B backbones (Voxtral-mini-3b and Qwen2.5-Omni-3B), WnW preserves near-Full-Cache accuracy while keeping only 20% of audio tokens on GPU, where prefill-only baselines fail to terminate. Results generalize across language, task, and domain shifts, and CPU-GPU recall adds little decode-time overhead in our measurements.

articles.titleCn: WnW：适用于长文本语音LLM的增减式KV缓存
articles.abstractCn: 长音频输入使得KV缓存成为语音大语言模型的主要内存成本。仅预填充的KV压缩方法在缓存被置换后永久丢弃音频KV位置，在解码过程中没有恢复它们的途径。我们证明这种方法在长音频上非常脆弱：预填充注意力集中在音频开头（产生注意力汇流效应），而解码时的注意力分布广泛，且这两种排序的关联性很弱。我们提出了WnW（增减式KV缓存），通过离线校准将KV头分为锚点、潮汐和固定三种角色。锚点头保留在GPU上，作为解码时的重要性观察者；潮汐头保留一个驻留在CPU上的补充部分，根据汇总的锚点头分数分块召回；固定头仅保留GPU上的子集，其余部分永久丢弃。在LibriSpeech-Long数据集上使用两个3B骨干网络（Voxtral-mini-3b和Qwen2.5-Omni-3B）时，WnW在保留接近全缓存准确率的同时，仅在GPU上保留20%的音频token，而仅预填充的基线方法无法终止。结果在语言、任务和领域迁移上具有泛化性，CPU-GPU召回在我们的测量中几乎不增加解码时开销。

articles.title: Enrich-Retrieve-Rank: Scaling Capability Discovery Beyond In-Context Routing
articles.abstract: Agent ecosystems now include thousands of MATS components (Models, Agents, Tools, and Skills), yet their discovery still relies on in-context routing. These systems read a registry (names, hints, or descriptions, as context budget permits), pick a candidate, invoke it, and retry on failure. This pattern degrades with scale, and registries are growing fast. We recast capability discovery as search over a registry by defining an offline enrichment step that turns sparse metadata into searchable profiles, and an online retrieve-then-rank pipeline that returns a ranked shortlist without invoking any candidates online. We show that from N=10 to 7,278 capabilities, in-context routing's top-1 accuracy (Match@1) collapses (0.85 to 0.12), while retrieve-then-rank degrades more gently (0.81 to 0.39) because its reranker still ranks the right capability first 0.70-0.87 of the time once retrieval finds it. In the Nova Micro sweep, the crossover is around N=500. We compare against two in-context baselines. Full-Ctx puts the whole registry in the prompt and asks the LLM to pick. Search&Pick gives the LLM a search tool to narrow candidates before it picks. At full scale the pipeline leads Search&Pick by 6.5 percentage points (pp) on Match@1 at about half the cost. It reduces cost 70x versus Full-Ctx. We use a fixed configuration (same enrichment, retriever, and scorer weights) across agent, tool, and skill registries. The pipeline runs in production as the default capability-discovery layer of a large-scale multi-agent platform.
articles.titleCn: Enrich-Retrieve-Rank：超越上下文路由，扩展能力发现的可扩展性
articles.abstractCn: 当前智能体生态系统已包含数千个MATS组件（模型、智能体、工具和技能），但它们的发现仍依赖上下文路由。这些系统会读取注册表（根据上下文预算限制，包括名称、提示或描述），选择一个候选项，在失败时进行重试。这种模式随着规模扩大而性能下降，而注册表正在快速增长。我们将能力发现重新定义为对注册表的搜索，通过定义一个离线增强步骤将稀疏元数据转换为可搜索的配置文件，以及一个在线检索后排序的流程，该流程在不在线调用任何候选项的情况下返回一个排序后的短列表。我们证明，从N=10到7,278个能力，上下文路由的Top-1准确率（Match@1）急剧下降（从0.85降至0.12），而检索后排序的下降更为平缓（从0.81降至0.39），因为一旦检索找到正确的候选项，其重排序器仍有70%-87%的时间能将正确的候选项排在首位。在Nova Micro测试中，交叉点大约在N=500附近。我们与两个上下文基线进行了比较。Full-Ctx将整个注册表放入提示中，并要求大语言模型（LLM）进行选择。Search&Pick给LLM一个搜索工具，以便在它选择之前缩小候选范围。在完整规模下，该流程在Match@1上领先Search&Pick 6.5个百分点（pp），成本约为后者的一半。与Full-Ctx相比，成本降低了70倍。我们在智能体、工具和技能注册表之间使用固定的配置（相同的增强、检索器和评分器权重）。该流程作为大规模多智能体平台默认的能力发现层在生产环境中运行。
